hero.subtitle: The freshest and most visual way to manage shared and personal expenses. No receipts arguments, no annoying spreadsheets.

audience.title: Built for your daily life, whoever you share with
audience.subtitle: Not just for couples. Pacho adapts to real everyday life with independent pouches for each group.

couples.title: Couples
couples.desc: Peaceful living: rent, groceries, dinners, and shared savings goals without mixing personal money.

roommates.title: Flatmates
roommates.desc: Utilities, internet, supplies, and cleaning. Everything tracked and settled month by month in one tap.

friends.title: Friend Groups
friends.desc: Barbecues, festivals, weekend getaways, and birthday gifts without the WhatsApp group chaos.

siblings.title: Siblings
siblings.desc: Mom's anniversary gift, the family dog vet bill, or shared subscriptions.

family.title: Parents & Teens
family.desc: Practical financial education: assign school expenses or allowances with visual pouches.

emulator.title: Try it right now
emulator.subtitle: Interact with this live clone of the app. Add expenses, switch pouches, and inspect balances. No sign-up required, 100% in your browser.
emulator.resetWarning: 💡 Changes run in browser memory and reset when refreshing the page.

pachoGuide.title: Meet Pacho, your money guide
pachoGuide.subtitle: An endearing guide with a beret and pouch who turns cold numbers into peace of mind and healthy habits.
pachoGuide.quote: «Clear accounts and thick chocolate. Keep your finances split with zero hassle.»
pachoGuide.pillar1Desc: Separate personal money from shared funds. Nobody sees what you spend on your personal hobbies.
pachoGuide.pillar2Desc: A dark, smooth, tactile interface that is a joy to open every single day.
pachoGuide.pillar3Desc: Helpful, friendly reminders when it's time to settle balances or celebrate reaching a savings milestone.

techPortal.title: Engineering Behind Pacho
techPortal.subtitle: Engineered under high architectural standards with modern performance and clean design.
techPortal.card1Desc: Feature-Sliced Design with strict layers (app, pages, widgets, features, entities, shared) for high modularity and clean separation.
techPortal.card2Desc: Sub-second load times, lightweight CSS variables with no runtime overhead, and 60fps animations with Framer Motion.
techPortal.card3Desc: Instant multi-device synchronization backed by strict Row Level Security (RLS) for complete user privacy.
techPortal.card4Desc: Native mobile core in Flutter (`mobile/`) sharing identical pouch philosophy and visual language.

pricing.title: Start free, scale whenever you need
pricing.subtitle: All essentials always free. Advanced features for those who want granular control.

footer.tagline: Shared and personal finances with zero headaches.
footer.madeWith: Crafted with care, clean code, and Spanish soul.
footer.disclaimer: Pacho is not a bank and does not store banking credentials. Your money and accounts always stay under your control.
